review.tdd: S14 has a semantic RED against the prior direct-write/queue adapter; the three independent review regressions also have documented assertion failures before their fixes. The 20-assertion GREEN case exercises the adapter, real owner commit and receipt replay, file publication faults, identity, and private intent content.
review.durability: The adapter returns queued and jobId only for an accepted owner receipt. Post-publication rejection, unavailable owner, and lost ACK retain the file and return enqueue_failed without jobId. The real owner replay returns the same documentId, desiredRevision, and jobId.
review.identity: The guarded new-save publication separates equal-body calls in one millisecond while explicit intentId replay stays idempotent. A real junction-root owner test retains the seeded lexical ledger source identity without a duplicate source.
review.compatibility: The strict eight-tool interface remains unchanged. The HTTP parity assertion changes degraded to enqueue_failed for a missing owner, consistent with the new durable-acceptance contract; no assertions were removed. S08, S09, S10, S12, and S13 still pass.

limits: This review does not claim a packaged Electron smoke run or simultaneous legacy-writer stress coverage; those are outside the S14 focused evidence and remain later migration work.
